# AMC Dune

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A calm, warm style: sand neutrals, a deep indigo primary that leads every action, a sparing terracotta accent and soft long shadows, made for HR and hospitality apps.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_dune.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-dune.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-dune.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-dune` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita. The page and header are warm sand, regions float on soft long shadows, and a deep indigo primary (WCAG AA with white text) carries buttons, links, the current menu entry and focus. Terracotta appears only as a thin accent (the header underline and the current menu marker), never as a status color, so danger stays clearly red. Uses the system font stack. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
